title: Meta must pay – level 1
paragraphs: A court in the US tells Meta to pay a very big fine. Meta owns Facebook and Instagram.

The judge says Meta does not protect children on the internet. The company knows about online dangers, but it does not help young people. Now Meta must pay lots of money to help children who are hurt. Meta must also make new rules for its apps. Meta says it tries to keep young people safe. The company wants to fight the court decision.
Some people want more rules to stop bad things online. Other people think that children need better help from their parents to stay safe online.

words.d: money a person or company must pay for breaking a rule
